usedFor: Facebook Messenger receives page messages, and Google Meet books a call through “Schedule a Meeting” on each “New Page Message”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Page Message” in Facebook Messenger, then “Schedule a Meeting” in Google Meet
bestTemplate.why: A customer who writes to your page gets a video call scheduled without a back and forth.

watchOut: “New Page Message” runs on every message, so one conversation can book several meetings with “Schedule a Meeting”.
